deny_matrix.rule: No matching ROUTES entry ->404; PUT/PATCH/DELETE ->405; forbidden gateway tokens and exact allowed route set add a second denial. No LLM or approval relay route exists.
D2 one door and §24.4 deny n8n direct access. Code binds services loopback in intended unit configurations; actual egress/firewall/mount isolation unproven in this audit. No network tests were run.

Workflow checker restricts HTTP URL origin; fixed relay methods expose no caller destination. Relay transport uses urllib default redirects and configurable gateway_url without validated origin; no runtime no-redirect guard. Gateway URL is host-controlled env, so arbitrary bearer-only caller cannot supply it.

Relay run/event/intent closed body rejects credential fields. Gateway _reject_secret_material handles known names/patterns but _run otherwise open; gateway HTTP duplicates accepted. n8n generated credential should be relay Header Auth only.
